items.title: 56799_Red Norvo oral history interview
items.q: she worked down on the Barbary Coast with Tommy Lyman and all those people for a long while.

ctx.x: No. No. I don't know what he does, because they went down to San Francisco and she worked down on the Barbary Coast with Tommy Lyman and all those people for a long while.
Oh. Well listen, Red, I remember Mildred showing me a snapshot of her where she was a slender little thing.
